The Opportunity
Corner Brick 8-Unit — Heavy Lease-Up Upside

A rare corner brick multifamily offered exclusively off-market in Jersey City's Northern Heights corridor, with dual frontage on Kennedy Blvd and Hague St. Four of eight units are delivered vacant with registered rents in place, and the seller is confident three additional units will be open to leave — a path to re-rent the majority of the building at market. All tenants pay their own heat, hot water, electric and gas, keeping the landlord's expense load light. Clean motivation, no distress.

The seller has recently obtained an updated Green Card, an NFA letter for the underground oil tank (removed, with mild remediation completed), and an updated rent registration and expense sheet from the City dated June 6, 2026 — included below.
